---
name: New component
about: Propose a new component for the kit
labels: new component
---

**Name and what it is** (e.g. `TreeView`: a hierarchical list with expandable branches)

**Where you need it** (the screen or flow, and why the existing components do not cover it)

**ARIA pattern** (the WAI-ARIA APG pattern it follows, if any) **and keyboard**

**Props, snippets and events you have in mind**

**Texts it adds** (they go in `en` and `es` in `src/lib/i18n.ts`)

**Third-party libraries** (if any, it ships behind its own entry point as an optional peer, like
`tallao/map` and `tallao/code`)

**Family**: actions and feedback / forms / overlays and menus / navigation and layout / data /
generative UI
